0.1.0.description:
# Equilinox AP v0.1.0 Beta Release! ### View the [Setup Guide](https://github.com/AAces17/EquilinoxAPClient#setup-instructions) on the Github repository. Currently, only Windows is supported. ## Current Features:
  • Evolution Checks
  • Task Checks
  • Species Size Checks
  • Species Unlock Items
  • Two Goal options: Evolve a Camel, or Complete Every Task
  • DP options in YAML
  • Connection info saved in the save file
## Known Issues:
  • On pages with multiple text input fields, you click the icon that looks like a pen in a square to edit the field. You then need to click it again to stop editing that field before editing the next text field. This happens because I am using the game's built-in text field object, which does not automatically deselect when you select a different one (because in the vanilla game, there are never 2+ text fields in the same menu). This is something I'd like to fix because it is kind of annoying, but it doesn't break anything. Since it will likely be somewhat involved to actually fix, it'll be left as-is for now.
  • Certain characters in a world (save file) name stop the game from loading the world properly. I know of "-" and "." breaking things, so if you put these in the "World Name" field, it just removes them before creating the world. If you create a world that later will not show up in the "load world" menu, send me the world save file and I'll take a look at it (see the readme.md for instructions on how to do this, in the Reporting Issues section).
  • There are currently no Archipelago logos/icons in game. I plan to add them in a future update, replacing the rainbow circle currently used.
  • Deathlink is not currently supported. If you have ideas for what deathlink would look like in this game, feel free to share in the Equilinox thread in the AP discord server.
### For more information, see the [README](https://github.com/AAces17/EquilinoxAPClient/blob/master/README.md).
